I loved it so much I bought two for my parents, who also love it. After owning it for several months here are my pros/con:  Pros: amazing battery life- lasts at minimum a month and I brush my teeth 2-3 times a day for the full two minutes. And to think, I've been avoiding getting this kind of brush because I thought how could one little round brush clean better than the larger brushes? Well, it does!!!!! Bristle quality is good and is working flawlessly till now (1 month use)  2) The travel hard case is compact and can carry 2 brushheads . Charging is no issue for me despite no adapter included , just the usb cable . Though you will not need to charge it often .  3) Brush holds quite well standing in the holder provided

I wanted an electric toothbrush and opted for this over the much more expensive Sonicare toothbrush and I am very pleased with the results.  There are multiple vibration levels and toothbrush head options.  Purchasing replacement heads has proven to be financially reasonable and easily accessible, as well. Absolutely love this Sonic Toothbrush! First its shipping speed is very prompt, and then after receiving the package, I saw the item is very neatly wrapped with multiple toothbrush heads--2 for tongue and 2 for teeth. Third, its battery stays for insanely amount of time, very durable to use. reviews.t: Super soft with my gum and good price
reviews.x: Now there are tons of toothbrushes in the market, however I bought this because its sensitive brush head and mode. I have been using this electrical toothbrush for around two months and its sensitive brush head already shows like new. It is easy to recharge and use. Its battery is long lasting, the portable case is in my backpack. I recommend it.

Not going to lie I picked this out quickly and didn't notice till it arrived that it wasn't a Phillips brand.  None the less it was $35 so we decided to just go with it.  It's not 1/2 bad.  It's USB which might be good or bad depending on how you like to plug things in.  But it cleans my teeth and I feel like it's a similar enough product.

reviews.t: I CANNOT GET REPLACEMENT HEADS FOR THIS TOOTHBRUSH!
reviews.x: Apparently this toothbrush, which I bought for my son about a year ago, is no longer available... in which case, neither are the replacement brush heads! This is bad business to sell something that you cannot get all of the parts to only a year later.

The toothbrush is great, it’s really soft and comes with multiple heads. Plus the battery life is extremely long so you won’t have to charge it as much. Overall great price for this product and probably one of the best you can buy for this price.

Such an amazing product. I used to clean my teeth with regular toothbrush, but this one change my ind and my smile. They look much lighter and healthy. I spent less time to clean them. I also changed toothpaste and add some soda

reviews.x: GREAT toothbrush but it vibrates more than brushes .. IT stops every 30 second which is VERY VERY annoying.  I use this gizmo for 4 minutes to make my mouth feel as equally refreshed as my $10 brush I bought from walgreens with a charger back in 2010 which they no longer sell and I can not find, that was the best brush I seen and I have perfect teeth, I am 45 and I use JANINA TOOTHPASTE ( google it and use it, it works ).... this brush could get 5 stars if 2 things happened .. 1) spinning head,

What a difference between the traditional way of brushing your teeth.  This device is powerful!  The toothbrush arrived with a decent charge and was excited to test it out and I was blown away by how easy and effective it was. My mouth has never felt more clean!  I picked this up for my wife and she’s been using it every days for a week and she absolutely loves it. She feels like her teeth are whiter as well.  Great value over way more expensive brands.

Noticed the difference with one time use. I've used a sonic toothbrush for several years. The darn thing never broke down. Decided to look for a new one and Planned to spend below $100.  I found this highly rated $36 sonic cool and thought I'd give it a try. Wow!  Noticed from the first use how super clean my teeth felt. I was very happy with my purchase, so much so that I bought 5 more for family members for Christmas.

I needed an extra electric toothbrush. I was looking for Sonicare because I’m already using one. Honestly I thought why this Sonicare so cheap and I ordered them thinking it was Sonicare. My surprise these are good as Sonicare. They don’t have exact same features but they are great if you need 2nd or 3rd one for work or gym. They have the same clean feel after using them.

reviews.t: An Excellent Electric Toothbrush at an Electrically Excellent Price
reviews.x: This is my first electric toothbrush. While I can’t compare it to expensive brands recommended by my dentist, I find that it cleans my teeth/gums well and has the same functions and features as ‘higher-end’ versions. There are multiple settings, additional brush heads, and a travel case. I think this is a great option for someone looking for a reasonably-priced brush.

This is the second electric toothbrush I have used. This is has whitening option which pleases me a lot tbh. The packaging was good and in white and also there comes few toothbrush heads to be replaced necessarily. It works strong enough and I feel better and cleaner as I have been using this for a week.

reviews.t: Better than Phillips in look, functions, convenience
reviews.x: As I opened this package I was ready to say goodbye to my old phillips sonic care. The box itself was durable, the cases were precise, and even every toothbrush head came with a cover. Intuitive look all around and I am excited to see how long this will last me.

I used the single toothbrush with replacement heads for me and my kids. I marked each replacement head so i knew who was whos. My kids like it and its easier and cleaner than a manual toothbrush. Great battery life. This is my favorite electric toothbrush

claims.text: Many reviewers consider it great value for the money, especially compared to pricier brands like Sonicare.
Reviewers frequently praise the long battery life and quiet operation.
Several reviewers like that it comes with multiple brush heads, including tongue-cleaning and sensitive options.
Some reviewers complain that the charger is USB-only with no wall power brick included.
A few reviewers report difficulty finding replacement brush heads.
